brief: Martin of Porres lived all his life in Peru. He was born in 1579, the illegitimate son of a Spanish knight and a coloured woman. He became a Dominican lay brother. He is remembered for his outstanding work with the sick, the poor and with African slaves, as well as for his lifelong efforts to reconcile and heal the differences in a multiracial society. Because of his willingness to perform the most menial tasks, he was nicknamed “Brother Broom”. He died in 1639.
